rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count eighty-four thousand
locative indicating the vast number in which beings are situated
compound denoting the devices or realms of birth
describes the afflicted condition of beings in those realms

items.question: What condition afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: Beings are situated within these womb-mechanisms.
These beings are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings located in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms suffer torment.
uncertainties: The implied subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse but is understood from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
